axiom_ledger.inference_and_applicability: Under the frozen coding, condition 3 is B and condition 2 is G. The standard visible-color ordering λB < λG, together with E = hc/λ and h,c > 0, implies EB > EG. This applies to the photon energy associated with the LEDs' named colors and does not imply anything about absorption or kinetics.
